pr_title: [Merged by Bors] - Add get_multiple and get_multiple_mut APIs for Query and QueryState
pr_body:
# Objective

- The inability to have multiple active mutable borrows into a query is a common source of borrow-checker pain for users.
- This is a pointless restriction if and only if we can guarantee that the entities they are accessing are unique.
- This could already by bypassed with get_unchecked, but that is an extremely unsafe API.
- Closes https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/issues/2042.

## Solution

- Add `get_multiple`, `get_multiple_mut` and their unchecked equivalents (`multiple` and `multiple_mut`) to `Query` and `QueryState`.
- Improve the `QueryEntityError` type to provide more useful error information.

## Changelog

- Added `get_multiple`, `get_multiple_mut` and their unchecked equivalents (`multiple` and `multiple_mut`) to Query and QueryState.

## Migration Guide

- The `QueryEntityError` enum now has a `AliasedMutability variant, and returns the offending entity.

## Context

This is a fresh attempt at #3333; rebasing was behaving very badly and it was important to rebase on top of the recent query soundness fixes. Many thanks to all the reviewers in that thread, especially @BoxyUwU for the help with lifetimes.

## To-do

- [x] Add compile fail tests
- [x] Successfully deduplicate code
- [x] Decide what to do about failing doc tests
- [x] Get some reviews for lifetime soundness
pr_comments: @yilinwei @nakedible @mathspy I really appreciated your reviews over in #3333; care to take a look at the new attempt?

This should have some tests that the entity aliasing logic is actually correct. The compile fail tests also seem somewhat insufficient to me, it doesnt check that `get_multiple` lifetimes are correct. 
I didnt think about using a `fn(q: Query<..>)` for compile fail tests instead of direct world access, that is interesting :)

> does ? not work here, regardless this all seems correct to me.

Nope: I need to work with a `&Result` (because I can't move it), which gives:

> the `?` operator can only be applied to values that implement `Try`
> the trait `Try` is not implemented for `&Result<<<Q as fetch::WorldQuery>::ReadOnlyFetch as fetch::Fetch<'_, '_>>::Item, 
> query::state::QueryEntityError>`

I tried this too originally T_T

I can just say that looks good and even better than the last one, thanks for continuing this. I did read through the pull once to know exactly what was in there, but don't have time for a proper review now.

> So, I fixed this @cart, by making the underlying QueryState::get_read_only_manual unsafe.

You didn't fix that. `Query::get_multiple` will still call `validate_world()` internally, when it definitely shouldn't. `Query::get_multiple_mut` is fixed though.

issue_context.title: Safe method for multiple mutable references to components from Query
comments:
This functionality is definitely valuable; see #2010 for another version of how this might look, and check out the [Relations RFC](https://github.com/bevyengine/rfcs/pull/18) that inspired it.

As a stop-gap, #1763 provides a limited but very commonly useful version of this functionality.
See #2276 for more thoughts on the API design here.

review_comments:
This test is failing because of weird lifetime nonsense.

```
error[E0623]: lifetime mismatch
  --> src\system\query.rs:815:82
   |
24 | fn spring_forces(spring_query: Query<&Spring>, mut mass_query: Query<(&Position, &mut Force)>){
   |                                                                ------------------------------ this type is declared with multiple lifetimes...
...
27 |          let [(position_1, mut force_1), (position_2, mut force_2)] = mass_query.multiple_mut(spring.connected_entities);
   |                                                                                  ^^^^^^^^^^^^ ...but data with one lifetime flows into the other here
   ```
Well that's a pretty bad error message...... there are two lifetimes on `Query` so its not obvious to me that we are confusing rustc with `&Position` and `&mut Force`

I can silence the error by joining the `Query` lifetimes:

```rust
   fn spring_forces<'w, 's>(spring_query: Query<&Spring>, mut mass_query: Query<'s,'s, (&Position, &mut Force)>){
```

But then that leads to:

```
24 | fn spring_forces<'w, 's>(spring_query: Query<&Spring>, mut mass_query: Query<'s,'s, (&Position, &mut Force)>){
   |                      -- lifetime `'s` defined here
...
27 |          let [(position_1, mut force_1), (position_2, mut force_2)] = mass_query.multiple_mut(spring.connected_entities);
   |                                                                       ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
   |                                                                       |
   |                                                                       `mass_query` was mutably borrowed here in the previous iteration of the loop
   |                                                                       argument requires that `mass_query` is borrowed for `'s`
```
